title: Volume Worksheets: Unit Cubes and Layers
intro: Teach volume by building and counting equal layers.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Count the unit cubes in one layer, including hidden cubes, then multiply by the number of layers.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

3 × 4 × 2 = 24 cubic units

Rows × cubes in each row × layers counts every unit cube once.

Ask your student

How many cubes are in each complete layer?

If your student needs help

If the student counts only visible faces, build or sketch a layer separately.
